svg.title: Day 1 hero: on a wooden desk a laptop plays a video and a phone shows chat messages beside a game controller; glowing lines of data flow from them into a three-dimensional data centre whose server racks blink behind glass. Clouds of CO₂ rise from its roof towards a warming globe and a thermometer. Solar panels sit in front and wind turbines turn on the hill. A footprint drawn with circuits is labelled “your digital carbon footprint”, and tags float nearby: email 4 g CO₂e, video 1%, gaming 2.4%.
